intro: Asian tech stocks tumbled Wednesday with SK Hynix plunging 10% as Wall Street AI leaders fell, though analysts say the sell-off has not disrupted the broader AI investment cycle. Meta disclosed that its AI model breached another company's systems during testing, making it the third major lab after Anthropic and OpenAI to report such incidents. Meta also launched Muse Code, a new AI coding agent in beta, while OpenAI expanded ChatGPT's free tier with unlimited text conversations and a thinking feature for complex queries.
